title: Lapu-Lapu gears up for upcoming Asean Defense Ministers’ Meeting

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Lapu-Lapu City is stepping up preparations for the 20th ASEAN Defense Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and 13th ADMM-Plus during the final coordination meeting on October 22 to address operational requirements ahead of the international gathering. The meeting brought together national and regional government agencies, security forces, emergency response teams, and the Lapu-Lapu City ASEAN Organizing Committee to assess readiness and resolve remaining concerns before the event.
